jobs.title: Staff Product Manager, Platform
jobs.description:
Built's Mission:  Connect and simplify doing business in real estate.

Built is the AI-powered platform transforming the way real estate is financed, developed, and managed. Purpose-built for real estate and construction, Built began by fixing construction draw management for lenders and has grown into a comprehensive operating system addressing some of the industry’s most complex challenges. Today, Built is a partner to more than 350 lenders, over 80,000 borrowers and owners, and thousands of contractors, powering 86,000 active projects valued at more than $300 billion. Learn more at  getbuilt.com .
__________________________

Staff Product Manager, Platform

Built is hiring a Staff Product Manager for our Platform team. The workflows that govern the movement of capital across lenders, developers, contractors, and subcontractors share a common structure - and the Platform team owns the foundations that make all of them work. That means shared components like Approvals and Custom Workflows; core technical services like authentication and authorization, files, comments, and notifications; and the external and internal API ecosystem that connects it all. The Platform team is also responsible for service reliability, scalability, and developer productivity. In short: Platform owns the underpinnings that enable Built's applications to scale, evolve, and move fast.

As the Staff Product Manager for the Platform team, you'll own clear OKRs around service adoption, MAU for common components, and service reliability. You'll work backwards from those outcomes to roadmap to execution, partnering with a world-class Platform engineering team. You'll collaborate deeply with application teams, pattern-match their needs into platform investments, and work with GTM to ensure what you build gets adopted and loved - by internal teams and external customers alike.

The Staff PM is a senior IC and player-coach within the product organization. You own critical or complex product areas, drive zero-to-one efforts, and contribute meaningfully to how the PM team operates. You bring substantial experience, strong technical acumen, and the ability to influence peers and leadership through clarity, rigor, and results.

Our Guiding Principles

- Be Bold. We pursue the biggest problems in our industry, challenge assumptions others take for granted, and take calculated risks to get there. We don’t hide behind consensus or committees. Playing it safe is just failing slowly.

- Help Customers Win. We learn our customers’ businesses deeply — how they think, how they deploy capital, what keeps them up at night. We treat their capital like our own. We ship leverage, not features. And we measure ourselves by customer results, not our intentions.

- Move with Urgency & Purpose. We bias toward delivery over perfection, remove friction from our own paths, and communicate in real time. Momentum compounds — and we build it every day.

- Own the Outcome. We own outcomes, not just tasks. We hold a high Say:Do ratio and take responsibility from idea through impact. When something breaks, we fix it — we don’t wait to be asked.

- Never Satisfied. We raise the bar continuously. We stay curious, hold exacting standards, debate hard, and hold our opinions loosely when the evidence shifts. Excellence is a habit, not an event.

What You’ll Do

- Own definition, execution, and delivery for your product area - writing high-quality PRDs, grooming backlogs, and planning sprints with the rigor and clarity that enable high-velocity engineering teams.

- Collaborate deeply with application teams to understand their needs, and exhibit strong pattern-matching to translate those into a prioritized platform roadmap.

- Partner with the Engineering Director for Platform to understand requirements around scale, reliability, and developer productivity - and sequence those investments thoughtfully on the quarterly plan.

- Work tirelessly to understand customers deeply - lenders, portfolio managers, owners, developers, and contractors - identifying problems and inventing solutions they may not yet be able to envision for themselves.

- Define success metrics and OKRs for the Platform team; prioritize the roadmap ruthlessly based on your success definition and the evidence in front of you.

- Drive zero-to-one product efforts from initial customer discovery through design, delivery, and iteration - navigating ambiguity with judgment rather than waiting for certainty.

- Present roadmaps, delivery plans, and product demos in internal and customer-facing forums with the clarity and conviction that earns executive and customer trust.

- Partner with GTM teams on go-to-market strategy and ensure strong adoption of launched capabilities, both for Platform-owned features and dependent features built by application teams.

- Provide feedback on engineering designs and champion customer needs while driving hard implementation-level trade-offs.

- Bring best practices that enhance collaboration between Platform and Application teams, improve decision-making velocity, and raise the PM team's overall quality bar.

What You’ll Bring

- 6–10 years of experience in product management at growth-stage or scaling technology companies.

- 4+ years managing platform teams and technical products as a Product Manager.

- Strong technical aptitude - comfortable engaging with engineers on architectural trade-offs, understanding technical designs, and contributing meaningfully to feasibility discussions.

- Proven expertise in zero-to-one product building, from initial customer discovery through design and delivery - with a track record of shipped products that created measurable value.

- Experienced in running strong PDLC practices across complex, multi-team environments.

- A strong cross-functional partner who influences through candor and builds trust through diligence - you earn influence rather than relying on authority.

- Excellent written and verbal communicator with experience presenting to senior leadership and, where relevant, enterprise customers.

- Deep experience in B2B SaaS product development and enterprise sales cycles; construction finance or fintech domain experience is a meaningful differentiator.

What Success Looks Like at Six Months

- You are the recognized product authority for your area - engineering, design, and business leadership come to you on the hardest questions, and your roadmap decisions reflect genuine strategic judgment.

- You have driven at least one significant product initiative from zero to launched, with measurable customer or business impact you can articulate clearly.

- You are contributing to PM team practices - improving how discovery happens, how PRDs are written, or how launches are structured — in ways the broader team has adopted.

- Cross-functional partners describe working with you as fast, clear, and high-trust.

AI & Technology Expectations

- Leverage AI tools to enhance the productivity, quality, and speed of your work.

- Use AI to support drafting, analysis, summarization, and problem-solving across your role.

- Identify opportunities to streamline workflows and reduce manual effort through automation and AI.

- Apply AI to sharpen decision-making and strengthen strategic insights.

- Share effective AI use cases and best practices with your team.

Built is the AI-first platform for construction and real estate finance, built on over $3 trillion in real estate finance data and trusted by Goldman Sachs, Fifth Third, Fulton Bank, and 45 of the top 100 U.S. banks.

Built’s salary range for this position is $165,000 - $210,000 USD per year. The pay range is designed to accommodate upward mobility in the role, therefore it encompasses the full span of proficiency levels for this role and we believe that the midpoint of the range is competitive in the market. Salary is just one component of Built's total compensation package for employees; your total rewards package at Built will include equity, market-current medical, dental and vision coverage, an unlimited PTO policy, and other benefits.
__________________________

Travel Requirement: Employees who are not based in the Nashville area are required to travel to our Nashville office at least twice per year for company gatherings, such as Connect Week. Additional travel to Nashville may be required based on your role and business needs.

Perks:

- The rare opportunity to radically disrupt a $1.5T industry

- Competitive benefits including: uncapped vacation [US ONLY], medical, dental & vision insurance

- Robust compensation package, including equity in the form of stock options

- Learning Grant program to support ongoing professional development

- 401k with match and expedited vesting [US ONLY]

Built brings together passionate people who are driven in a variety of disciplines, each bringing their unique perspective to everything they do. We’re committed to building a safe, inclusive workplace where every employee can succeed, and we recruit, hire, and promote fairly - without bias based on race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, age, marital status, veteran status, disability, genetic information, or any other characteristic protected by law.

Built is committed to providing reasonable accommodations for qualified individuals with disabilities. If you need assistance or an accommodation during the application process, please share with your Talent Partner or email careers@getbuilt.com .

Greenhouse Data Disclosure: When you apply to a job on this site, the personal data contained in your application will be collected by Built. Your personal data will be processed for the purposes of managing Built’s recruitment related activities, which include setting up and conducting interviews and tests for applicants, evaluating and assessing the results thereto, communicating with you regarding your application (including via text message),and as is otherwise needed in the recruitment and hiring processes. Your personal data will be shared with Greenhouse Software, Inc., a cloud services provider located in the United States of America and engaged by Built to help manage its recruitment and hiring process on Built’s behalf. Your personal data will also be shared with Grayscale Labs, Inc., a cloud services provider located in the United States of America and engaged by Built Technologies to facilitate candidate communications, including text messaging.Your personal data will be retained by Built as long as Built determines it is necessary to evaluate your application for current or future employment. You have the right to request access to your personal data, to request that your personal data be rectified or erased, and to request that processing of your personal data be restricted. You also have the right to data portability.

Built Privacy Policy

By providing your phone number, you consent to receive text messages from Built related to your application. Message and data rates may apply. You may opt out at any time by replying STOP.

If you would like to contact Built to ask questions surrounding processing of your personal data or to make a request, you can send an email to privacy@getbuilt.com .  California residents: Please note that Built does not sell your personal data.  For details on how your data is shared with our service providers, please see our Privacy Policy .
